market_summary: During the mid London session, all six tracked instruments are trading within their session Value Areas, characterized by compressed volatility envelopes and normal to sub-average RVOL (<1.1). FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and Metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) are pinned tightly against flat to slightly declining VWAPs and POC levels, testing immediate structural supports without high-volume breakout interest. US100 and BTCUSD are consolidating after mean-reversion bounces from earlier session lows, stalling right below overhead VWAP/EMA50 resistance bands. Given the absence of yellow RVOL expansion spikes and lack of clean structural sweeps across the board, strict discipline requires a universal HOLD until New York liquidity generates confirmed directional momentum.
